newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin up six cents to 14.29 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin up six cents to 14.29 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price edged up six cents to 14.23 ringgit ($5.67) a kg on active buying after a higher overnight close on the London Metal Exchange (LME).
"The LME prompted some strong buying, especially from Japan," said a trader. The London market closed $50 up on Tuesday.

Initial bids were 179 tonnes against offers of 137. Apart from Japanese buyers, orders came in from European and Malaysian interests. Turnover was up to 159 tonnes from 125 on Tuesday. The local premium over London narrowed to $50 from $100.
